entities.summary: Dani Shapiro is an American writer, the author of six novels including Family History (2003), Black & White (2007) and Signal Fires (2022) and the memoirs Slow Motion (1998), Devotion (2010), Hourglass (2017), and Inheritance (2019). She has also written for magazines such as The New Yorker, The Oprah Magazine, Vogue, and Elle. In February 2019, she created a podcast on iHeartRadio called Family Secrets.
